summary.text: Customers find the dog bed well-made, comfortable, and easy to wash by removing the inner padding. The memory foam receives mixed feedback - while some praise its top-notch quality, others note the cheap standard foam. Customers disagree on the bed's durability, with some reporting it lasts up to 3 years while others say the cover falls apart after a year. Assembly experiences vary, with some finding it easy to assemble and wash while others struggle with the process. Value for money is also mixed, with some considering it worth the price while others find it too expensive.

authors_reviews.title: Phenomenal Luxury Orthopedic (for real tho) dog bed
authors_reviews.text: This pet bed is so comfortable and plush that I think I would like to get one for myself as a mattress!I have a senior dog and while this is definitely a luxury item, I wanted to spoil her this year and this bed definitely fit the bill. She loves it so much and it is so thick and keeps her so far off the ground, I know it’s great for temperature control and comfort.I have a 50 pound husky mix, and the medium size worked just fine because her preference is to sleep in a tiny ball. We did buy her a back-up bed that’s larger from a different brand to see if it was more important to her to be able to stretch out, and she still sleeps in both of them in a tiny ball, so now we have one for upstairs and downstairs. Again, it is an expensive purchase, so we’re not buying a second one right now, but I think next year we will definitely be investing to replace the other one.I really love how all the pieces come apart and you can wash the cover if you need to.Oh my gosh! They also included a little stuffed dog frisbee in the packaging, so thoughtful. I’m not sure if that’s a limited holiday treat, but we appreciated that too.Again, senior dog, but we do put medical ointment on her feet, and that does appear to be staining the bed, otherwise haven’t had any issues with staining, and I know that the paw stuff has oil in it so we’re not too worried about the bed. Oil stains are a pain but we prefer happy paws.We’ll see if that comes out when we give it a wash, and we thought about it when we got the lighter color, but it is a dog bed - it doesn’t need to be pristine.I haven’t had a chance to test the waterproof or lack of state, but that is a point the review prompt is asking about, so I just wanted to address that it hasn’t come up for us just yet.Fully support and encourage this purchase if you have a pet you love and would love to spoil, or if there’s someone else in your life who has a beloved pet, this would be such an impactful gift.
authors_reviews.author: K

authors_reviews.title: Favorite dog bed so far
authors_reviews.text: I get on these kicks looking at dog beds, in search of the perfect one. I'm not going to say this one is perfect, but it's my favorite we've ever had! We have a 65 pound boxer who is 3 years old. He likes to sleep on anything comfy (that may or may not be made for dogs). As you can see in the pictures, he enjoys his Casper bed! So it is dog approved - he lays on it often and both curls up and stretches out. He likes the bolsters. But I also approve it! I like how thick and firm the mattress is and the 4 bolster inserts. The cover material is sturdy and feels like it'll last (it's been in the washer and dryer just once so far), but still comfy enough to attract the pup. I like how they designed the cover and zippers - putting it together is easy and it holds it's original shape. The only thing I wish is that there was a size between the medium and large. We got the large and I wish it were a tad smaller. But I think the medium would be too small since he does like to stretch out, too. It doesn't bother me enough to want a different bed. If I do buy him another bed, it will likely be this very one. I'm telling you, we've had several brands and styles... And I'm really liking this one. Pricier than I've spent on dog beds, but I'm glad I did!
authors_reviews.author: SBK

authors_reviews.title: smart design, great for older dog
authors_reviews.text: We have an elderly dog with declining mobility and most dog beds are too fluffy - they catch on her feet when she tries to turn to lay down, or they have high side bolsters that she can't get over very well. This bed is perfect for her. The firmness of the foam is just right to cushion her joints and bones while supportive enough for her to walk on without getting caught up. The side bolsters are very slight - just enough to give stability to the edges of the bed and a slight rise for her head, without being a tripping hazard.The design is the best-thought-out that I have encountered. Each foam section has a liner covering, and the actual cover has a seperate zip compartment for the main central rectangle - there's no squeezing or smashing of stuffing into place - everything slots in smoothly, zips with a nice fit and hidden zipper, and the end of the zipper is even covered to protect the floor. And I know that it will be easy to remove and replace the cover for washing.My *only* complaint is that we really need a size between medium and large - large is really really big, but medium is too small for our dog.Kudos to Casper for a great, well-thought out product!
authors_reviews.author: Starhaven

authors_reviews.title: Expensive but with it!
authors_reviews.text: UPDATE: A little over a year later and cover has begun to rip on top. So yes it has held up longer than other beds, but I'm disappointed it didn't hold up longer for the price. Casper sells a replacement cover, but it's insanely overpriced. Basically half the cost of the bed! I think I'm being generous only taking one star off the review. I would say this is closer to a 3.5 if you expect durability.Original 5 star review---------My dog likes to dig when settling down—which means I’ve gone through an absurd number of dog beds this year.While I have a Casper mattress myself, I was reluctant to spend so much for a dog bed. But after wasting so much money on cheaper beds, I finally gave in, and why do I feel like a fool for not doing it sooner! In fact, within a month, I ordered a second one.The design and cover of these beds are durable, and allows your dog to dig without any destruction. So while it may cost more than other beds, it’s gonna last. Since my dog also likes to lay up against something, the raised edges are a huge plus.

other_countries_reviews.title: Le meilleur panier pour chien !
other_countries_reviews.text: J’avais acheté ce même panier orthopédique, il y a de ça 7-8 ans en arrière, lorsque la marque CASPER distribuait encore en Suisse. Mon chien adore ce panier. Il l’a accompagné jusqu’à aujourd’hui et il est encore en excellent état ! Je cherchais désespérément un deuxième panier orthopédique pour le mettre dans une autre pièce, mais impossible d’en trouver un de la même qualité et du même confort. Alors quand j’ai vu que je pouvais le commander sur Amazon j’ai sauté sur l’occasion et je ne regrette pas du tout ! Exactement la même qualité qu’à l’époque. Il est parfait ! Surtout pour les chien plus âgés avec des soucis d’arthrose (ce qui est le cas du mien). Je sais que le prix peut en dissuader plus d’un, mais faites-moi confiance, il durera dans le temps !
